user: Model a stand for 5 standard 1 cm spectrophotometer cuvettes. The stand is one rectangular block, 100 mm in X, 28 mm in Y and 25 mm high, centred on the origin in X and Y and standing on z = 0. A row of 5 square pockets runs along X, each 13 mm by 13 mm and 22 mm deep, opened from the top face and spaced 18 mm apart centre to centre; the row is centred on the block. The pockets stop 3 mm above the bottom face.

Design a horizontal rest for a pipette. A flat base plate 180 mm long (X), 35 mm wide (Y) and 4 mm thick sits on the bed (z = 0 to 4), centred on the origin. At each end of the plate, flush with that end, an upright block 10 mm thick in X and as wide as the plate rises from z = 0 to z = 40. Cut a cradle into the top of each upright: a semicircular notch of radius 8 mm whose centre lies on the top edge at y = 0, z = 40, running through the upright along X.

Create a bench mat that stops 1 Petri dish (35 mm) from sliding. It is a flat plate 52 mm (X) by 52 mm (Y), 5 mm thick, lying on the bed with its centre at the origin. Into the top face cut one circular recess 36 mm in diameter and 3 mm deep, centred on the plate.

Design a flat wrench for loosening hexagonal caps on reagent bottles. It is a single plate 5 mm thick lying on the bed (z = 0 to 5). It consists of a round head, a disc 55 mm in diameter centred on the origin, and a straight handle, a bar 16 mm wide (Y) running from x = 0 to x = 90, centred on y = 0 and merged with the head. Through the head, centred on the origin, cut a regular hexagonal hole 24 mm across the flats, with two of its flats parallel to the X axis.

Design a holding block for writing labels on a tube lying on its side. It is a rectangular block 50 mm long (X), 24 mm wide (Y) and 18 mm tall (Z), centred on the origin in X and Y and standing on z = 0. A straight channel with a semicircular cross-section runs the full length of the top face along X: it is 13 mm in diameter and its axis lies along the top surface at y = 0, z = 18, so the channel is 6.5 mm deep.

Design an end block for a DIY syringe pump. It is a rectangular block 40 mm in X, 20 mm in Y and 28 mm in Z, centred on the origin in X and Y and resting on z = 0. A horizontal bore 9 mm in diameter passes straight through the block along Y; its axis is at x = 0, z = 14. Two vertical mounting holes, each 4.5 mm in diameter, go through the full height at x = -14 and x = 14, y = 0.

Design an organiser block for hex keys. It is a rectangular block 72 mm long (X), 16 mm wide (Y) and 25 mm tall (Z), centred on the origin in X and Y, standing on z = 0. Along the X axis (y = 0), 10 mm apart and centred on the block, cut 6 vertical hexagonal pockets 12 mm deep from the top face. From -X to +X their sizes across the flats are 1.9, 2.4, 2.9, 3.4, 4.4, 5.4 mm; every hexagon has two flats parallel to the X axis.

Design a flat spacer ring that raises an instrument off the bench. It is an annulus 4 mm thick lying on the bed, centred on the origin, with an outer diameter of 90 mm and an inner diameter of 66 mm. 8 through-holes, each 4.5 mm in diameter, are evenly spaced on a 78 mm diameter circle, the first one on the +X axis.

Design a drying board for glassware. A flat base plate 105 mm (X) by 80 mm (Y) and 6 mm thick lies on the bed (z = 0 to 6), centred on the origin. Standing on its top face is a 4 by 3 grid of vertical round pegs (4 along X, 3 along Y), each 8 mm in diameter, rising from z = 6 to z = 66; the pegs are 25 mm apart centre to centre in both directions and the grid is centred on the plate.

Design a frame that holds a diffuser sheet over a lab light pad. It is a flat rectangular frame 4 mm thick lying on the bed, centred on the origin: outer size 180 by 90 mm (X by Y), with a rectangular window 160 by 70 mm cut through its middle, so the border is 10 mm wide all round. A 4.5 mm through-hole sits in the border at each of the four corners, at x = ±85, y = ±40.

Design an adjustable shim plate. It is a flat plate 80 mm long (X), 24 mm wide (Y) and 4 mm thick, lying on the bed with its centre at the origin. It has two through-slots for bolts, both running along X with fully rounded ends: each slot is 5.5 mm wide and 12 mm long overall (end to end), and the slots are centred at x = -20 and x = 20, y = 0.

Design a riser that lifts a microplate above the bench. It has a flat top plate 130 mm (X) by 100 mm (Y) and 4 mm thick whose top face is at z = 50, centred on the origin. Four square legs, each 15 by 15 mm, support it at the corners, flush with the plate's outer edges, running from z = 0 up to the underside of the plate. A rectangular window 80 by 50 mm is cut through the centre of the top plate.

Design a carrier disc that holds magnets for a rotating sample mixer. It is a cylinder 60 mm in diameter and 10 mm tall standing on the bed, centred on the origin. In its top face cut 2 round pockets for disc magnets, each 8.2 mm in diameter and 4 mm deep, evenly spaced on a 43.8 mm diameter circle with the first pocket on the +X axis. A 6 mm diameter hole runs through the centre for the motor shaft.

Design a mounting strip for screwing lab equipment to a wall. It is a flat bar 80 mm long (X), 24 mm wide (Y) and 6 mm thick, lying on the bed, centred on the origin. It has 2 screw holes along the X axis at y = 0, 50 mm apart and centred on the bar. Each hole is a 4.5 mm through-hole with a 90-degree countersink on the top face, 9 mm in diameter at the surface.

Design a divider insert for a sample storage box. It is an open lattice with no floor: an outer rectangular wall 122 mm by 62 mm (outside size, X by Y), 25 mm tall, standing on the bed and centred on the origin, split by straight internal walls into a 6 by 3 grid of equal open cells (6 along X, 3 along Y), each 18 mm square inside. All walls, outer and inner, are 2 mm thick.

Design a tubing organiser that keeps several lines side by side. It is a flat plate 80 mm long (X), 32 mm wide (Y) and 4 mm thick, lying on the bed, centred on the origin. Along its +Y edge cut 6 rectangular notches through the full thickness, each 5 mm wide (X) and 12 mm deep (into the plate, along -Y), spaced 11 mm apart centre to centre and centred along X.

Design a small reel for winding silicone tubing, printed lying on one flange. It is round about the Z axis: a bottom flange 70 mm in diameter from z = 0 to z = 3, a core 25 mm in diameter from z = 3 to z = 23, and a top flange 70 mm in diameter from z = 23 to z = 26. A 8 mm diameter bore runs straight through the centre along Z.
